correctness.rationale: For q≥2, r≥2, n≥r, all constrained overlap-graph vertices and edges are enumerated by legal length-(n−1) and length-n words. The imbalance indicator is exact. The leftmost a^(r−1) potential drops by at most one along any legal shift edge, giving an all-augmentation lower bound. Reversing the prefix preceding the first a^(r−1) yields paths of exactly the potential length; the last a^(r−1) in each sink reconstructs its unique source, giving a bijection and Eulerian optimality. Source enumeration derives the exact rational series. The standalone checker verifies 47 finite parameter cases, compares power-series coefficients, replays Euler tours, and exhaustively excludes shorter cycles in six small cases; the universal proof is combinatorial.

value.rationale: Solves the natural and non-Eulerian full run-limited window-coverage problem for all alphabet sizes, run limits, and lengths, with exact minimum, explicit Eulerian optimal construction, and an integral dual certificate. The gap between cyclically admissible and linearly admissible windows arises naturally in constrained channels, making the precise necessary repetition count meaningful beyond a finite table. The all-parameter rational GF and source–sink reversal structure are not cosmetic consequences of the binary r=2 result.
